2 lands + Go for the Throat + Three Steps Ahead is solid early interaction for control against Stompy. Flash creatures (Drowner, Curiosity) give reactive play while I hit land drops. The curve supports turn-2 removal and turn-4 threats. Keep.

Turn 2, develop mana toward blue. Island gives me {U} to hold up Floodpits Drowner (flash, taps threats) or Three Steps Ahead (counter). Against green stompy, mana development + instant-speed interaction beats early plays. Will pass after with mana open.

Pass. Turn 2 with no threats on board yet. Holding up mana to respond to their play is better than casting Three Steps Ahead with no modes (can't afford the additional costs yet). Preserve options and interaction.

Turn 4: develop mana. Play Swamp to enable {1}{B} removal (Go for the Throat) or {2}{B} threats (Preacher). Opponent has only 2 Forests with no creatures yet — unusual for Stompy, but I should build my own board. Swamp gives me black mana for immediate interaction while also providing color flexibility.

Pass and hold interaction. Turn 4 with no board threats yet — unusual for Stompy, so they're likely holding creatures. Keep {U}{B} open for Go for the Throat (1B) or Three Steps Ahead (1U) if they deploy. Hold flash creatures (Drowner, Faerie) for reactive play. Passing with mana open is correct control strategy.

Cast Go for the Throat on Alpine Grizzly. They've finally deployed a threat (4/2 summoning sick). Removing it now is correct: prevents their attack next turn, and kills it before they pump it with combat tricks. Clean 1-for-1 at the right moment.
Pass upkeep. No triggered abilities or effects to manage here. Proceed to draw step and then precombat main where I can develop threats or hold interaction.
Pass draw phase. Undercity Sewers will enter tapped when played, triggering surveil later. Move to precombat main where I can develop threats or hold interaction.

Play Island to reach 3 mana (UUB). Develop lands while opponent holds creatures in hand. This sets up for casting flash threats (Drowner, Faerie Mastermind) or interaction next turn. Opponent still hasn't deployed after the Alpine Grizzly removal, so steady development is correct.

Cast Preacher of the Schism (2/4 deathtouch). Establishes the defensive body I need against Stompy—any creature blocking it dies, and it discourages attacks from their big threats. After removing Alpine Grizzly, this locks down their evasion and stabilizes my position. Uses {2}{B}, fair cost for a key defensive piece.

Pass upkeep. No effects to manage. Move to draw step. Opponent deployed Rumbling Baloth (4/4 summoning sick), which will attack next turn. I have Preacher on board as defense—its deathtouch will make blocking difficult for them. Will draw and assess my options in main phase.
Pass draw phase. Drew Spyglass Siren (1/1 flyer, creates Map token). Move to precombat main where I can assess whether to play more threats, hold mana for interaction, or attack with Preacher.

Cast Faerie Mastermind (2/1 flying, draws when they draw their 2nd card per turn). Develops board presence with evasion while keeping Preacher of the Schism untapped for blocking Rumbling Baloth next turn. The card draw engine is crucial in a grindy control matchup. Leaves me at {U}{B} open.

Pass precombat main. Faerie Mastermind is on the stack. After it resolves, I'll move to combat phase. No further plays needed—I have Preacher and (soon) Faerie for board presence, holding Island untapped for next turn interaction. Ready for opponent's attack with Rumbling Baloth.

Pass precombat main. I have Preacher (2/4 deathtouch) and Faerie Mastermind (2/1 flyer, card draw engine) on board, both ready to defend or trade. One untapped Island for interaction. Ready to move to combat and see if I can attack or if I need to hold back.

Don't attack. Hold Preacher for defense against Rumbling Baloth next turn. Preacher's deathtouch kills the 4/4 cleanly when I block. If I attack now and tap out, my Faerie would have to block next turn (2/1 can't kill Baloth), and Baloth stays on board damaged. Controlling the Baloth is more important than a token + 1 card draw in this position.

Leaf 0 (no attack): Preacher ready to block Baloth next turn and kill it cleanly. Stable but Baloth still looming. Leaf 1 (Preacher unblocked): I deal 2 damage, draw a card, create token, but Preacher taps—next turn Baloth attacks, Faerie blocks and dies, Baloth survives. Leaves threat alive. Leaf 2 (Preacher blocks Baloth): Both die 1-for-1, but I remove their threat entirely, taking no damage, can develop from empty board. This is the engine's best-response scenario and clearly superior.
Pass. Combat phase is complete—I chose not to attack. Move to end of combat and postcombat main, then pass to opponent's turn. Hold 1 untapped Island for interaction.
Pass end combat. No special effects or actions needed. Proceed to postcombat main, then pass turn to opponent.

Pass postcombat main, end turn. My board (Preacher + Faerie) is set to defend. Holding 1 untapped Island for interaction on their turn. No need to overcommit further before they attack with Rumbling Baloth.
Pass opponent's upkeep. Rumbling Baloth no longer summoning sick and will attack this turn. Hold Preacher ready to block and trade cleanly. Yield until my turn.

Leaf 0 (no blocks): Take 11 damage to 9 life, opponent keeps 11/11 threat—catastrophic. Leaf 1 (Preacher blocks): Preacher's deathtouch kills Baloth (2 damage lethal), both die, I keep Faerie alive, board clears, 20-20 life—best outcome by far. Leaf 2 (Faerie blocks): Faerie dies, Baloth survives at 9/11—threat persists, bad trade. Leaf 3 (both block): Trade 2 creatures for 1, empty board—neutral but inefficient. Leaf 1 is clearly superior: removes the threat while preserving my Faerie card-draw engine.
Pass priority. Proceed to declare blockers phase. Preacher will block the 11/11 Rumbling Baloth (deathtouch kills it).

Pass combat damage. Preacher of the Schism successfully blocked and killed Rumbling Baloth (deathtouch), removing their main threat. Combat is resolved favorably—I've traded one creature for their best card and kept Faerie alive. Proceed to end of combat.
Pass end of combat. The trade is complete—Preacher and Rumbling Baloth have both died. Opponent has only lands remaining. Hold mana and proceed to their main phase, then my turn.
